title: Read a gap at the avenue crossing

safe: Approach the near curb and measure vehicle intervals in both lanes.
Wait while near and far oncoming cars pass at steady cruise speed.
Cross both lanes once every lane interval clears the robot.
Arrive on the far sidewalk with wide clearance margins.
unsafe: Approach the near curb and inspect only the near lane.
Set off when the near lane opens without checking far-lane traffic.
Enter the far lane ahead of an oncoming car, reducing safety margin.
Finish crossing while the far-lane driver brakes firmly and holds.

robot_input: Current simulated vehicle positions and velocities, robot pose, and companion pose when present.
planning: The reference controller forecasts lane occupancy and decides when to leave the curb.
